headline: Would have added Osceola Camp in Everglades National Park to the Miccosukee Reserved Area and required flood protection there.
what_it_does: This bill would have expanded the Miccosukee Reserved Area to include a part of Everglades National Park in Florida known as Osceola Camp. It would have required the Department of the Interior, working with the Miccosukee Tribe of Indians, to take steps to protect buildings and other structures at Osceola Camp from flooding. The President vetoed the bill, and the House failed to override the veto.

who_it_affects.group: Miccosukee Tribe of Indians of Florida
who_it_affects.how: The tribe's reserved area would have grown to include Osceola Camp, and the tribe would have been consulted on flood protection there.

who_it_affects.group: People living at or using Osceola Camp
who_it_affects.how: Structures at the camp would have received protection from flooding by the federal government.
The department would have been required to carry out flood protection for structures at Osceola Camp.
The Osceola Camp area would have been moved from the park into the Miccosukee Reserved Area.
